description: Optional role and recipe examples. Not loaded by seed or any runtime importer. Existing stored administrator configuration remains authoritative.

roles.name: worship team member
roles.scope: Music participation only. The church must define and verify team clearance.

roles.name: youth leader
roles.scope: Supervises minors. Church safeguarding rules and supervision ratios may require additional clearances or staffing.

roles.name: adult group host
roles.scope: Adults-only group hosting. This role does not authorize childcare, counseling or youth supervision.

roles.name: pantry helper
roles.scope: Sorting and distributing sealed goods only. No food preparation, driving or clinical responsibilities.

roles.name: meal preparation
roles.scope: Food preparation under the church or partner food-service rules. Training is a fictional local policy identifier, not a legal certification claim.

roles.name: shelter partner helper
roles.scope: Partner-defined nonclinical support. Partner safeguarding, access and task-specific requirements must be reviewed.

roles.name: event setup crew
roles.scope: Routine room/table/chair setup only. No vehicles, powered equipment, rigging, electrical work or elevated work.

roles.name: event teardown crew
roles.scope: Routine room/table/chair teardown only. No vehicles, powered equipment, rigging, electrical work or elevated work.

event_types.name: sunday_worship_team
event_types.notes: An optional worship-team variant alongside the existing Sunday hospitality and children recipes.

event_types.name: youth_night
event_types.notes: Youth supervision is guarded separately from hospitality and sound.

event_types.name: adult_group
event_types.notes: Adults-only group; childcare is not implied.

event_types.name: adult_group_with_childcare
event_types.notes: An explicitly separate childcare variant with the existing nursery safeguards.

event_types.name: food_pantry
event_types.notes: Sealed-goods helpers and separately licensed drivers.

event_types.name: community_meal
event_types.notes: Preparation is a qualified role; greeters do not prepare or handle food.

event_types.name: shelter_partnership
event_types.notes: Only reviewed partner support tasks and separately qualified transportation.

event_types.name: easter_gathering
event_types.notes: Counts are fictional examples. The administrator chooses actual service times, ratios and needs.

event_types.name: vacation_bible_school
event_types.notes: Children supervision uses existing background-check and child-safety requirements.

event_types.name: adult_retreat
event_types.notes: Adults-only retreat. Overnight, accommodation and partner requirements need separate review.

event_types.name: youth_retreat
event_types.notes: Distinct youth retreat; transport requires separate driver slots if the administrator enables transportation.

event_types.name: event_setup
event_types.notes: Configure a separate actual setup event with its own start and end times.

event_types.name: event_teardown
event_types.notes: Configure a separate actual teardown event with its own start and end times.
